verdict.rationale: The pack documents a RESTful API with JWT auth, regional endpoints and a dated changelog, but nothing describes a webhook/callback registration or a documented task-status polling endpoint that reports a render as finished or failed. The only failure-related item covers credit billing, not job-state notification. The axis clearly applies to a generation API, so absent evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, my system learns a render finished or failed through a webhook or a documented pollable job status
